# Ticket page (generated by the program)
@from lc-wms, control-center
> 1 Header, title and chips on top, then sections in reading order. lc-wms brief page is the model.
> The page is generated from the TOML and markdown files; nobody edits it by hand (F28, F33).
> Decisions get a real table here, which control-center's drawer lacks. Files are clickable.
